svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: PAIRS Lab research overview
svg.desc: Robot autonomy at PAIRS Lab: 1. Active and Semantic SLAM (Where am I, and what is around me?); 2. Robust Perception and Autonomous Navigation (How do I move safely in hard conditions?); 3. Robot Learning and Human–Robot Interaction (How do I learn skills and work with people?); 4. Agentic Robotics and Industrial Vision (How do I plan tasks and deliver them in industry?). Flows: 1 to 2: maps & poses; 2 to 3: safe motion; 3 to 4: skills; 4 to 1: tasks & goals. Platforms: Quadrotor UAV, TurtleBot 4, UR3 arm, Pi Mouse, Dual-arm robot. Applications: Industrial inspection, Solar-farm monitoring, Service robots, Factory safety, Smart traffic.
